name: Flowise
summary: Open-source visual builder for AI agents and chatbots.
description: Flowise lets you visually assemble agents, chatbots and document-search pipelines by connecting models, vector stores and tools. Self-host it or use the cloud, and expose flows via API.
features: Tool calling to SaaS APIs and internal systems.
Monitoring, logs, or human handoff where offered.
Templates to start from common automations.

howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

summary_fr: Outil open source pour construire des agents et chatbots IA par blocs.
description_fr: Flowise permet d'assembler visuellement des agents, chatbots et pipelines de recherche documentaire en reliant modèles, bases vectorielles et outils. Il s'installe soi-même ou s'utilise dans le cloud, et expose les flux par API.
